design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_garm.lo.ja: 街道を荒らす獣を討った者に、宿場の人々が贈った粗い勲章。牙の跡が残る。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_garm.lo.en: A rough medal the waystation folk gave whoever brought down the highway beast. It still bears tooth marks.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_hook.lo.ja: 射手の赤い眼光を映し返したという小鏡。覗くと狙いが澄む。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_hook.lo.en: A little mirror said to have thrown back the archer's red glare. Looking into it steadies the aim.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_durn.lo.ja: 大猪の牙を削って編んだ足環。追い詰められるほど足が前へ出る。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_durn.lo.en: An anklet of carved boar tusk. The more you are cornered, the harder your feet push forward.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_nebula..ja: 月夜にだけ落ちる古老の羽。倒した命の名残をそっと持ち主に渡す。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_nebula..en: A feather the elder sheds only on moonlit nights. It passes a little of each fallen life to its bearer.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_bellado.ja: 魔女の胸元を飾っていた紫水晶。触れた刃に宵の毒が宿る。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_bellado.en: The violet stone that once sat at the witch's breast. Any blade it touches carries the dusk's venom.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_lunar.l.ja: 狼王の抜け落ちた牙を連ねた数珠。身を翻す一瞬が見えるようになる。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_lunar.l.en: Beads strung from the wolf king's shed fangs. You begin to see the instant to twist aside.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_dolga.l.ja: 坑道の死者を守り続けた墓守の冠。触れる者には痛みを返す。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_dolga.l.en: The crown of the warden who kept watch over the dead of the shafts. It returns pain to those who touch it.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_rustbon.ja: 錆びた骨で組まれた人形。矢を受けた敵の足を重くする。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_rustbon.en: A doll pieced together from rusted bones. Foes it marks walk as if their feet were lead.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_vein_ea.ja: 大ムカデの腹から出た青い鉱晶。急所を穿つ一撃が深くなる。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_vein_ea.en: A blue ore crystal found in the great centipede's belly. Blows that find a weak spot bite deeper.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_goura.l.ja: 滝壺の底で磨かれた鏡。水の重みが身体を太くする。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_goura.l.en: A mirror polished at the bottom of the plunge pool. The weight of the water thickens the body.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_mistwea.ja: 霧の糸を編んだ額冠。腕が糸のように軽くなる。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_mistwea.en: A circlet woven from threads of mist. Your arms grow as light as silk.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_ord.lor.ja: 大亀の甲羅を削った数珠。身にまとうと背に甲羅を負うようだ。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_ord.lor.en: Beads carved from the great tortoise's shell. Wearing them is like carrying its shell on your back.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_valka.l.ja: 倒れるまで戦い続けた狂戦士の勲章。傷が深いほど腕が冴える。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_valka.l.en: The medal of a berserker who fought until she fell. The deeper the wound, the keener the arm.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_scorch_.ja: 燃える眼の主が残した火の羽。放つ一撃に火が移る。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_scorch_.en: A burning feather left by the scorching eye. Every strike you loose catches its flame.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_agnis.l.ja: 遺跡の神像の額にはめられていた冠。技に古い神の力が宿る。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_agnis.l.en: The circlet set on the ruin idol's brow. An old god's strength flows into your arts.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_alvin.l.ja: 天翔ける聖騎士が祈りに使った数珠。癒しの手が温かくなる。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_alvin.l.en: The beads the paladin of the peaks prayed with. Healing hands grow warm.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_peak_sn.ja: 峰の狙撃手が誇りにしていた勲章。外さない一射が致命になる。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_peak_sn.en: The medal the peak sniper took pride in. The shot that does not miss becomes the fatal one.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_zephyr..ja: 雷を纏う翼から抜けた羽。打たれた敵が一瞬しびれる。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_zephyr..en: A feather torn from the thunder-clad wing. Foes it strikes freeze for a heartbeat.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_xenos.l.ja: 破滅を告げに来た者の冠。唱える言葉に終わりの響きが混じる。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_xenos.l.en: The crown of the one who came to announce ruin. Your words carry an echo of the end.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_black_k.ja: 黒騎士の盾から削り出された鏡。刃を向けた者が自らを斬る。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_black_k.en: A mirror cut from the black knight's shield. Whoever raises a blade against you cuts themselves.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_nihil.l.ja: 虚無を喰む竜の鱗を留めたブローチ。斬った傷から命を吸う。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_nihil.l.en: A brooch holding a scale of the void-gnawing drake. It drinks life from every cut.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_brutus..ja: 暴れ牛の角を連ねた数珠。重い一撃が相手を揺さぶる。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_brutus..en: Beads strung from the rampaging bull's horns. Heavy blows leave the foe reeling.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_harvest.ja: 収穫泥棒の頭目が逃げ足自慢に着けていた足環。足取りが軽くなる。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_harvest.en: The anklet the harvest thieves' chief boasted his quick feet with. Your step grows light.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_strom.ja: 案山子の身代わり人形

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_strom.l.ja: 案山子の王が畑に立てていた人形。近づく者の足を止める。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_strom.l.en: One of the dolls the scarecrow king set up in his fields. It stops whoever comes near.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_melusin.ja: 湖の魔女が水面の光を閉じ込めた宝石。魔法が澄んで鋭くなる。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_melusin.en: A gem in which the lake witch caught the light on the water. Spells grow clear and sharp.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_drowned.ja: 沈んだ漁師の網に絡んでいた鏡。銛のような傷を残す。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_drowned.en: A mirror tangled in the drowned fisher's net. It leaves wounds like a harpoon's.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_numel.l.ja: 湖底の主のぬめりを帯びた足環。攻撃がつるりと滑っていく。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_numel.l.en: An anklet slick with the lakebed lord's slime. Attacks slide right off you.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_barbas..ja: 隻眼の船長の帽子に挿してあった羽。運のいい一撃が増える。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_barbas..en: The feather from the one-eyed captain's hat. Lucky blows come more often.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_dock_br.ja: 港の喧嘩で負け知らずだった男の勲章。拳が速くなる。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_dock_br.en: The medal of a man who never lost a fight on the docks. Your fists move faster.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_ankara..ja: 大ガニの甲殻で作られた人形。代わりに打撃を受け止める。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_lord_ankara..en: A doll made from the great crab's shell. It takes the blows meant for you.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d1_a.ja: 失われた地下都市の貴族が着けていた銀細工。盗賊たちも手を出さなかった。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d1_a.en: Silverwork worn by a noble of the lost undercity. Even the bandits left it alone.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d1_c.ja: 地下水路に流された人形。拾った者の身代わりに危機をかわす。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d1_c.en: A doll set adrift in the undercity canals. It dodges danger in its finder's place.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d2_a.ja: 古代樹の若枝で編まれた冠。癒しの力が芽吹く。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d2_a.en: A circlet woven from the ancient tree's young twigs. Healing power sprouts within.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d2_c.ja: 迷宮の樹精が落とした緑の羽。命が巡るのを感じる。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d2_c.en: A green feather dropped by the labyrinth's dryad. You feel life flowing around you.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d3_a.ja: 砂塵の神殿の神官が授けられた勲章。太陽の熱が腕に宿る。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d3_a.en: A medal granted to the priests of the sandstorm temple. The sun's heat dwells in your arms.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d3_c.ja: 神殿の砂金を固めた数珠。窮地でこそ輝く。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d3_c.en: Beads pressed from the temple's gold dust. They shine brightest in a tight spot.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d4_a.ja: 凍てつく地下牢の囚人を繋いでいた鎖。その恨みが刃を研ぐ。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d4_a.en: The chain that bound the prisoners of the frozen dungeon. Their grudge hones your blade.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d4_c.ja: 氷の牢の壁から切り出した鏡。打ちかかる者を凍える痛みが襲う。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d4_c.en: A mirror cut from the wall of an ice cell. Freezing pain answers anyone who strikes.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d5_a.ja: 氷結の城の庭に咲く氷の花の冠。触れたものを凍らせる。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d5_a.en: A crown of the ice flowers in the frozen castle's garden. Whatever it touches freezes.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d5_c.ja: 女王の白鳥が残した羽。舞うように攻撃をかわす。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d5_c.en: A feather the queen's swan left behind. You slip past attacks as if dancing.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d6_a.ja: 火山洞窟の溶岩が冷え固まった石。今もかすかに熱を放つ。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d6_a.en: Stone formed where the volcano's lava cooled. It still gives off a faint heat.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d6_c.ja: 竜王の鱗を縫い付けた人形。持ち主の身体を頑丈にする。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d6_c.en: A doll stitched with the dragon king's scales. It makes its owner sturdy.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d7_a.ja: 古代遺跡の機関から外された歯車の勲章。技の回転が上がる。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d7_a.en: A medal made from a gear taken out of the ancient ruins' engine. Your arts spin faster.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d7_c.ja: 雲海を映す鏡。放つ雷光が敵を縫い止める。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d7_c.en: A mirror that shows the sea of clouds. Your lightning pins foes in place.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d8_a.ja: 終焉の塔の門番が戴いていた黒い冠。致命の一撃を研ぎ澄ます。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d8_a.en: The black crown the tower's gatekeeper wore. It sharpens the killing blow.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d8_c.ja: 塔の虚ろから拾い集めた珠。斬るたびに命が戻る。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_d8_c.en: Pearls gathered from the tower's hollows. Life returns with every cut.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_fina.ja: 終焉の王の外套を留めていた紅玉。王の一撃の重さを知る。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_fina.en: The ruby that fastened the King of the End's mantle. It knows the weight of a king's blow.

design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_fina.ja: 玉座の間に掛けられていた鏡。追い詰められた者に最後の力を貸す。
design.eternalrealm.trinket_dungeon_fina.en: The mirror that hung in the throne room. It lends one last strength to the cornered.
